compatibility_changes: App receives a ready RequestHandler, not a config path; getContainer removed
RouteEntry and RouteResult receive RequestHandler objects, not class names
HTTP config is Closure(Logger):App for both SAPI and RoadRunner
Migration CLI second argument is a directory; sources loaded explicitly without application autoload
PostgreSQLStorage construction no longer connects; connection errors occur on the first SQL/transaction/lastInsertId
RR-specific composition files/providers removed; RR_HTTP_CHUNK_SIZE selects adapter chunking

http_check.includes: attachments, bounded streaming and successive requests in the same worker

checks: default core GET/HEAD/404/405 through SAPI/RR with unavailable DB
default migration directory and explicit catalog directory without application namespace registration
catalog migration/seed, list/cursor/detail/private rejection and GET/HEAD PDF through SAPI/RR
21 generated typed rows with explicit SqlExecutor
baseline JSON without DB and JSON/SELECT through source SAPI/RR
invalid CLI action/directory rejected before connection
CLI rollback/reapply/seed preserves expected migration state
runtime-only manifest hash and archive boundaries; no container or RR profiles

cli_comparison.scope: CLI core composition plus 10000 in-process GET /health calls, no network/DB/SAPI emission; correctness checked for every body, streams closed
cli_comparison.warmup: One discarded process per variant; no artificial request warmup within each measured process
cli_comparison.limits: PHP counters are not RSS; timings include fixed correctness checks and body closing. These short CLI runs do not establish FPM/RR throughput, latency or long-running memory stability.

probe_source:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$start = hrtime(true);
require $argv[1] . '/bootstrap.php';
if ($argv[2] === 'before') {
    $app = new App\Platform\Runtime\App($argv[1] . '/config/core.php');
} else {
    $compose = require $argv[1] . '/config/core.php';
    $app = $compose(new App\Platform\Logging\ReadableOutputLogger());
}
$startupNanoseconds = hrtime(true) - $start;
$classes = count(get_declared_classes());
$graphBytes = memory_get_usage();
$request = new Nyholm\Psr7\ServerRequest('GET', '/health', ['X-Request-ID' => 'composition-measure']);
$start = hrtime(true);
for ($i = 0; $i < 10000; ++$i) {
    $response = $app->handle($request);
    if ($response->getStatusCode() !== 200 || (string) $response->getBody() !== '{"status":"ok"}') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Different measured response.');
    }
    $response->getBody()->close();
    unset($response);
}
echo json_encode([
    'startup_ms' => $startupNanoseconds / 1000000,
    'requests_ms' => (hrtime(true) - $start) / 1000000,
    'loaded_classes' => $classes,
    'graph_php_bytes' => $graphBytes,
    'after_requests_php_bytes' => memory_get_usage(),
    'peak_php_bytes' => memory_get_peak_usage(),
], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), "\n";
